title: Government of the Republic of South Africa v Grootboom (2000)
summary: Courts may require government programmes to meet minimum core socio-economic rights obligations over time.
principle: Justiciable socio-economic rights and progressive realisation.

title: Minister of Health v Treatment Action Campaign (2002)
summary: Government must roll out nevirapine to reduce mother-to-child HIV transmission where medically indicated.
principle: Health rights and reasonable state measures.

title: S v Makwanyane (1995)
summary: Constitutional Court abolished the death penalty as inconsistent with dignity and rights culture.
principle: Right to life and dignity in criminal justice.

title: Certification of the Constitution (1996)
summary: Constitutional Court certified the final Constitution complied with constitutional principles.

title: Occupiers of 51 Olivia Road v City of Johannesburg (2008)
summary: Meaningful engagement required before evictions affecting access to adequate housing.

title: Glenister v President (2011)
summary: Independence of anti-corruption bodies assessed against constitutional rule-of-law values.

title: EFF v Speaker of the National Assembly (illustrative parliamentary disputes)
summary: Courts sometimes referee parliamentary discipline against constitutional free-speech guarantees for members.
